dishes.name: Schäufele
dishes.desc: Roast pork shoulder with a crackling crust, served with potato dumplings and cabbage or salad. The classic Sunday roast of Franconian inns around Bamberg.

dishes.name: Bamberger Hörnla
dishes.desc: Crescent-shaped butter yeast pastry, folded like a croissant and made in Bamberg for centuries. Found in the town's old bakeries.

dishes.name: Stuffed Bamberg onion
dishes.desc: Local onion hollowed out and filled with minced meat, baked in smoked-beer sauce. It pairs Bamberg's onion growing with its smoked beer tradition.

dishes.name: Coburger Bratwurst
dishes.desc: Coarse beef-and-pork sausage grilled over pine cones and eaten in a long roll. Coburg's own bratwurst, sold at stands on the market square.

dishes.name: Coburger Schmätzchen
dishes.desc: Small meringue-and-hazelnut sweets in the shape of a kiss, a Coburg confectionery specialty from the old ducal town.
